This is taking longer than usual.
Walk around town, talk to people, solve five tasks: shopping, delivery, quiz and a chat at the till.
Pictures flash, you write them down from memory — strictly, diacritics included. A hundred levels, three hearts.
The castellan is in hospital and every key is hidden. Twelve rooms, one key at a time, before the town council votes to sell the fortress.
Guests order in the accusative, you serve from pictures. Eight shifts, more items and adjectives each time.
You pick the stake. Push word crates into the garage of their category. Bigger stake, bigger warehouse.
Fill the wagons before departure. The rule keeps changing: category, gender, first letter, translation.
Collect only the words of the given category. Intruders cost you hearts, ghosts chase you.
Eat letters in the right order to spell the word on the picture. A wrong letter costs a heart.
Two shores and a lighthouse. Jump into the cloud with the right word, climb to the portal and cross to the other side. Crabs climb too.
Twenty correct answers against the clock. Hits go to your mastered list, misses to the review list.
Words fall towards your base, you click the translation. Fifteen waves, both directions, four answers along the bottom.
All 128 towns of Croatia, from Ilok on the Danube to Dubrovnik. In each one a person talks to you in Croatian and only one of three replies fits. Three hearts that never come back.
